modeled_geometry.levels: Five levels reflect both NUM_LEVELS and CountOfFLO. Floor-to-floor heights and whether any count denotes a basement are unverified.
modeled_geometry.facade: Repeated glazing is an illustrative pattern; brick and modest covered entry are qualitative cues from the building-specific photo. Exact window count, size, materials by elevation, and entrance orientation remain estimates.
modeled_geometry.service_addition: A darker southeast boundary finish indicates the documented attached BSL-3 addition at a qualitative location. Its separate outline and dimensions are not documented in the cited source and are not invented as a measured footprint.
modeled_geometry.interior: No interior modeled. The GIS's Floorplans attribute points to an unavailable internal G: drive file. No room layout is claimed.
modeled_geometry.roof_equipment: Omitted because no building-specific roof survey or sufficiently clear roof evidence was found.
